chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
For all animals, the buyer has a three-day option; he has the choice during that period whether he stipulated it or did not stipulate it.

key_terms.الْحَيَوَانِ: animals; the class of goods to which this ruling applies
key_terms.بِالْخِيَارِ: possessing the option to confirm or rescind the sale
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ: three days; the duration of the buyer's option
key_terms.شَرْطُ: stipulated condition or established option in the contract context
key_terms.لِلْمُشْتَرِي: for the buyer; identifying who holds this right

ai.seo_question: Does a buyer have an automatic three-day option in the sale of animals in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling in sales involving animals: the buyer has a three-day option to rescind the transaction. This right applies regardless of whether the condition was explicitly mentioned in the sale contract.
